id: title:jabahamondes:show paid event counts in source suggestions

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies and restricts connection suggestions and volume calculations to paid events, preventing user confusion regarding report attribution and warehouse sync.
review.reason: The chunk is a documentation and implementation change. P1.F1.H1 adds documentation clarifying that connection suggestions do not affect report attribution or warehouse sync. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 change volume calculations and evidence text to use paid events only, not total events. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and documentation change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed documentation and implementation changes, but the actual benefit and user impact are not independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation change. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a documentation file explaining the new paid-event-only ranking and its limitations.
observations.code_quote: These counts guide connection suggestions; they do not change report attribution or connected-source sync checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that connection suggestions are not used for report attribution or warehouse sync, preventing user confusion.

observations.behavior: Changes the volume calculation and evidence text to use paid events only, not total events.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the suggestion evidence and volume to reflect only paid attribution, not total event volume.

observations.behavior: Updates the evidence text and event_volume parameter to use paid_volume and an event_label.
